body:
Dogfooding the TS emitter against DEADWEIGHT's card_rules.prn found and fixed three real bugs: I32/I32 division wasn't truncating toward zero (Math.trunc fix), tb_appendf's 512-byte buffer silently truncated long expressions (same bug already fixed in emit_java.c, ported here), and (not x) fell through into a bogus call (same fix as emit.c/emit_java.c/BURROW). test_emit_ts.c 21->30 assertions. Verified against all 105 cards + 2808 fx-amount parity vectors, 0 mismatches. Commits 0af718d, 6f5dd25.

⚓ ☃
title: TypeScript emitter: I32 division truncation + 511-char buffer overflow + (not x) fixed
